Short title and commencement

ACT II OF 1975
ACT II OF 1975
FRONTIER CORPS
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1974
An Act further to
amend the Frontier Corps Ordinance, 1959
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 17th January 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 13th January 1975, and is hereby
published for general information :-
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Frontier Corps (Amendment)
Act, 1974.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

General Amendment, Ordinance XXVI of 1959

ACT II OF 1975

(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1974
An Act further to
amend the Frontier Corps Ordinance, 1959
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 17th January 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 13th January 1975, and is hereby
published for general information :-
2. General Amendment,
Ordinance XXVI of 1959.----In the Frontier Corps Ordinance, 1959 (XXVI of
1959), hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, for the words
"Central Government", wherever occurring, the words "Federal
Government" shall be substituted.

3. Amendment of section 2,
Ordinance XXVI of 1959.---In the said Ordinance, in section 2-
(a) in clause (cc), for the word
"the" the word "a" shall be substituted and shall be deemed
always to have been so substituted ; and
(b) in clause (e), for the word
"the" the word "an" shall be substituted and shall be
deemed always to have been so substituted.

Amendment of section 5, Ordinance XXVI of 1959

The following Act of Parliament

4. Amendment of section 5,
Ordinance XXVI of 1959.---In the said Ordinance, in section 5,-
(a) in subsection (1), for the
words and commas "the Inspector-General, Frontier Corps, the Deputy
Inspector-General, Frontier Corps," the words and commas "as many
Inspectors-General, Frontier Corps, and Deputy Inspectors-General, Frontier
Corps, as it considers necessary" shall be sub stituted and shall be
deemed always to have been. so substituted ; and
(b) after subsection (1) amended
as aforesaid, the following new sub section shall be inserted, namely:--
"(1-A) Where the Federal Government appoints more
than one Inspector General or Deputy Inspector-General, it shall, by
notification in the official Gazette, specify the area within which each one of
them shall exercise jurisdiction under this Ordinance.".
